summary: A future in Quote mode, then Depth on top: the feed moves the instrument from mode 2 to mode 3 at mStock and back; a full packet gives the Quote frame its OI and the Depth frame its book; a Quote packet has no OI to send.

deviations.reason: mStock's Quote packet (123 bytes) carries no open interest; the web sends oi 0 for it (mstock_adapter.py:369), an invented zero a client reads as a real OI. The desktop leaves oi out until a packet has carried one.
deviations.ref: decisions 2026-11-09: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out; web openalgo#2376

deviations.reason: Once a full packet has carried open interest, the web's Quote packet still sends oi 0 over it; the desktop keeps the last OI the instrument's full packet carried on this connection.
